_comment: How the board groups lists. Rules run in order and the first match wins, so put the specific ones first. `match` entries are matched against the slugified list name: an entry with no wildcard must match the whole slug, and one containing * is a substring rule. Anything unmatched falls into the last group, so a new list always lands somewhere.
